description: Synthetic curated ALSM engineering benchmark for COBOL-to-Java semantic validation. It contains clean controls and intentionally injected defects; it is not customer or production code.
creationMethodology: Cases were created specifically for ALSM Phase 6 from small fictional business behaviors. Each mutated case begins with an understandable COBOL intent and injects one documented Java-side semantic mutation.
limitations: This is a small synthetic curated evaluation set and does not represent all production COBOL systems.
Ground-truth labels require independent human review and may contain judgment calls.
No claim is made that a foundation model has never seen similar programming patterns.
Passing these cases does not prove semantic equivalence for arbitrary programs.
